question: Can a fixed query-asymmetric rank-32 projection plus conservative per-row residual certificates preserve the exact pinned stock candidate set while avoiding material net physical output-head traffic on the same 32 exact rows?
causal_hypothesis: The 32 exact hidden rows span at most 32 dimensions, only 0.595238% of the 5376-wide head. A fixed orthonormal basis learned from those rows should make their query residuals numerically negligible, so a 262144-by-32 projected-weight index can produce tight row upper bounds and reduce exact tied-weight reads to a small physical union. The competing explanation is that conservative stock BF16 and projection residual guards keep the 32-query union near the full vocabulary despite the exact query span.

stock_control.selected_rows: the predecessor's same deterministic one-row-per-request selection
stock_control.sampler: pinned temperature-zero greedy argmax after monotone softcap and min-token stop masking
stock_control.candidate_set: every possible non-stop stock argmax under the inherited conservative FP32-reference, BF16-accumulation, and BF16-output-rounding envelope

candidate.name: fixed full-query-span low-rank residual index
candidate.rank_rule: numerical rank of the 32-by-5376 selected hidden matrix, capped at 32; no rank sweep
candidate.basis: float64 SVD right-singular basis of the same 32 selected hidden rows
candidate.projected_weights: float64 coefficients for every original token row; token order is unchanged
candidate.residual: explicit float64 per-row and per-query residual norms
candidate.bound: projected dot plus residual Cauchy term, basis-idempotence defect, float64 dot/subtraction guards, and the inherited stock numeric envelope
incumbents: optimistic oracle lower bound for the 10% gross-union possibility gate
implementable exact lower bound from one projected-score seed row per query
candidate.storage_semantics: the tied BF16 embedding/output matrix is not duplicated; the projected coefficients, basis, and residual norms are additional

workload.geometry: 32 selected hidden rows by 262144 token rows by hidden width 5376
workload.physical_scope: 32-query union of original tied-weight rows read for exact verification
traffic_charges: full original BF16 rows in the physical survivor union

correctness_gate.semantics: lossless containment of the pinned stock candidate set
required: exact input hashes, tensor geometry, dtype, and tensor digest match
all inputs and bounds are finite
every possible stock candidate row is retained by both oracle and implementable survivor sets
every dense reference winner is retained
all token rows remain directly reachable in original token order

decision_gate.discriminator_pass: oracle gross physical union weight-byte avoidance is at least 10%
decision_gate.implement_once: only after the discriminator passes, persist exactly one rank-32 index and evaluate the feasible seed incumbent
decision_gate.promote: exact stock-set containment and positive material net physical bytes after all declared traffic
decision_gate.falsify: the oracle misses 10% gross union avoidance, stock containment fails, or implementable net traffic is nonpositive
decision_gate.transfer_limit: CPU/reference and analytical byte accounting on an in-sample query-trained basis only; no H200, endpoint latency, held-out-query, or production-quality claim

artifact_contract.teardown: foreground CPU process exits; immutable hard-linked inputs remain; no provider, GPU, or external state exists
